trial_court: IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Vijayawada (F.C.O.P.No.396 of 2025)
case_name: Korraee Venkata Lakshmi Korada Rama vs Korraee Poorna

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Korraee Venkata Lakshmi @ Korada Rama Lakshmi, wife

facts_of_case: Petitioner is the legally wedded wife of respondent; their marriage was performed on 17.08.2024; due to matrimonial disputes, petitioner has been residing separately at her parents' house and seeking withdrawal of F.C.O.P.No.396 of 2025.

legal_principles.principle: If a wife does not have sufficient funds to visit the place where the divorce petition is filed by her husband, then the transfer petition filed by the wife may be allowed.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court in GEETA HEERA Vs HARISH CHANDER HEERA1 held considering this fact.
cited_cases: GEETA HEERA Vs HARISH CHANDER HEERA, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court in N.C.V. Aishwarya Vs A.S.Saravana Karthik Sha2 held as follows: '9. The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.'
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya Vs A.S.Saravana Karthik Sha2

outcome.final_order: The High Court may be pleased to withdraw F.C.O.P.No.396 of 2025 pending on the file of IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Vijayawada, Krishna District and transfer the same to Family Court Srikakulam.
